component.name: Viewer
component.summary: View images, documents, recordings, text and data

description.p: One window for the files you open every day: pictures, PDF documents, text and source code, Markdown, tables, JSON, fonts, archives, books and comics, audio and video.

Press Space on a file in your file manager for a quick look, or open it for the full viewer with zoom, search, page turning and playback. Recordings and camera raw or HEIC pictures are handled by your own mpv, FFmpeg and libheif tools through optional plugins; the viewer itself contains no codec.
